name: iLoveVideoEditor
tagline: Render real MP4 videos from JSON scene definitions or 249 motion-design templates
description: iLoveVideoEditor lets agents render production-quality MP4 videos: list motion-design templates, fill in template variables, submit JSON-to-MP4 render jobs, poll render status, and get signed download URLs. Deterministic and template-driven output with real text, images, captions, effects, and transitions — built for agent-generated marketing, social, and product videos.

install.notes: Renders are asynchronous jobs: submit with ilovevideoeditor_render_template or ilovevideoeditor_render_json, poll ilovevideoeditor_get_render_status until completed, then call ilovevideoeditor_get_download_url for the MP4.
